taskOverrides.scope: 2 dense Qwen-shaped layers · analytical cross-node FSDP
description: This is the measured dense-FSDP task with only FSDP communication changed to cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand. Every attention, MLP, root, and embedding compute duration is unchanged.
Each GPU/rank is assigned one 400 Gb/s rail: 50 GB/s peak and 42.5 GB/s effective at 85% efficiency. Eight rails provide 400 GB/s aggregate node injection, not 400 GB/s to each rank.
Each compute block keeps its measured duration but moves right when its corresponding parameter all-gather is incomplete. Reduce-scatters remain serialized on the FSDP reduction stream.
taskOverrides.insight: Cross-node all-gathers stall L1 forward, L1 backward, and L0 backward. The two FP32 reduce-scatters dominate the tail.

verification.label: Analytical NDR400 model · 42.5 GB/s effective per rank
verification.implementation: Measured NVLink compute with byte-derived cross-node FSDP collectives and explicit dependency rescheduling
verification.workload: Same two dense Qwen-shaped layers; only FSDP AG/RS communication changes from NVLink to one NDR400 rail per rank.
verification.measurement: 78.100 ms modeled window. Compute durations are unchanged; layer AG=9.204 ms and FP32 layer RS=18.358 ms.

l0-fwd-ag.description: Materialize the complete 424 MiB BF16 layer 0 parameter set from eight FSDP shards. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l1-fwd-ag.description: Layer 0's pre-forward path launches layer 1 prefetch immediately after L0 AG releases the serialized FSDP stream; it overlaps L0 attention. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

root-fwd-ag.description: The small shared final-norm/output FSDP state is prefetched while layer 0 MLP executes. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l1-attn-fwd.description: Layer 1 parameter copy-out, input norm, GQA attention kernels, output projection, and residual. Compute is shifted until the corresponding L1 forward AG completes.

l1-bwd-ag.description: The root output module prefetches layer 1 parameters for backward while output/loss backward executes. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

root-rs.description: Shard the root module gradients after its backward pass. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l0-bwd-ag.description: Layer 1 backward launches layer 0 parameter prefetch; it is fully hidden by L1 backward compute. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l0-mlp-bwd.description: Layer 0 parameter copy-out followed by dense SwiGLU and FFN-normalization backward. Compute is shifted until the corresponding L0 backward AG completes.

l1-rs.description: FP32 layer 1 gradient sharding begins about 5 µs after gradient packing and overlaps layer 0 MLP backward. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

embedding-bwd-ag.description: Layer 0 backward prefetches the embedding state. The embedding itself is outside the two-layer puzzle. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.

l0-rs.description: FP32 layer 0 gradient sharding begins about 6 µs after packing and forms the exposed communication tail. The gradient is ready earlier, but this RS waits for the serialized L1 RS.

embedding-rs.description: The final tiny embedding RS closes the captured backward window. Duration is analytically modeled over cross-node NDR400 InfiniBand.
